Je t'envoie des photos pour mon applicat: I’m sending you photos for my YOROI app, sometimes a whole folder taken on different dates: scale screens (any brand), screenshots from a smart scale app (Withings, Zepp Life or Mi Fit, Renpho, Eufy, Garmin Connect, Apple Health, Samsung Health, Google Fit...) with their history and charts with numbers, printed receipts or sheets (InBody, Tanita...), and body measurements in centimeters (note, notebook, screenshot). Read the values and copy them out. Rules: 1. Only copy the numbers you can see clearly. Don’t guess, don’t calculate, don’t convert anything. 2. If a value doesn’t appear anywhere, or if you have any doubt, don’t write its line. 3. Reply ONLY with the blocks below: no text before, after or between them, no explanation. 4. One line per value, in the format key: number, with a period for decimals. Keep the key names exactly as they are. No units, except for a mass in pounds or stones (write lb or st after the number, example: poids_kg: 12 st 4 lb) and for a length in inches (write in after the number). 5. One block per date, from YOROI BALANCE v1 to FIN. Everything measured on the same day goes into a single block, even if it comes from several photos (the scale in the morning, the tape measure in the evening). Photos arrive in any order and may repeat: a value seen on two photos is written only once. 6. The date of each block: look for it in this order. The date shown on the scale screen or in the app screenshot (date_source: ecran). The date printed on a receipt or sheet (date_source: ticket). Otherwise the date the photo was taken, if you have access to it or if it’s in the list “Photo capture dates” at the end of this message (date_source: photo). Write it in the format date: YYYY-MM-DD, and on the next line where it comes from: date_source: ecran, ticket or photo. If the day and month are visible but not the year, write date: DD/MM, the app will add the year. If you can’t find any date, write date: inconnue and date_source: inconnue, the app will ask for the day. A date visible on the photo always wins over the capture date. Never make up a date, don’t use the file date or the sending date, never today’s date. 7. App history or chart: each row showing a written date and number becomes a block at its date. Don’t read a value from the height of a curve, only written numbers. A weekly or monthly average is not a weigh-in: don’t write it. 8. Many scales (Tanita included) don’t write the name of the measurement: recognize it by its unit, its small symbol and its value range. kg with the standing figure, largest value: poids_kg. kg with the muscular figure (dumbbell), about 30 to 90: muscle_kg. Small kg, about 1 to 6, with the bone symbol: os_kg. % with the figure and the % symbol, about 3 to 50: graisse_pct. % with the water drop, about 35 to 75: eau_pct. Level: graisse_viscerale. Age: age_metabolique. kcal: metabolisme_kcal. kJ: metabolisme_kj, only if no screen gives the kcal (don’t convert). Single number with no unit from 1 to 9 with the figure symbol: physique. Decimal number with no unit, about 15 to 45, with BMI: imc. bpm or a heart: fc_repos. Degrees (°): angle_de_phase. Number like 0.380 with ECW/TBW: ratio_eau_extracellulaire. If two values could match the same key and you can’t decide, write neither. 9. Arms, legs, trunk from a scale (on a Tanita: the screens from the two orange buttons, fat in % and muscle in kg): the right or left side is the one shown by the scale or the sheet. If you don’t know which segment it is, don’t write the line. A “percentage of normal” (InBody) is not a percentage of the segment: put it on an autre line. 10. Tape measurements, in cm: use the key with the side if it’s written, otherwise the key without a side. An arm circumference in cm is not arm muscle in kg. 11. Any other measurement shown with its name, one line each, in the format: autre: Exact name shown = value unit Don’t write as autre a measurement that already has its own key. 12. If you know which photos the values in a block come from, add the line photos: with their numbers, in the order of the list or of sending (example: photos: 1, 2, 3). Otherwise don’t write this line. Possible keys (write only the ones you see): date: (YYYY-MM-DD, DD/MM without the year, or inconnue) date_source: (ecran, ticket, photo or inconnue: where the date comes from) photos: (numbers of the photos read for this block, optional) {0} Body measurements, in cm: {1} Arms, legs, trunk from a scale, with SEGMENT = bras_droit, bras_gauche, tronc, jambe_droite or jambe_gauche: graisse_SEGMENT_pct: (segment fat in %) graisse_SEGMENT_kg: (segment fat in kg) muscle_SEGMENT_kg: (segment muscle in kg) muscle_SEGMENT_pct: (segment muscle in %) eau_SEGMENT_kg: (segment water in kg or liters) Example of the expected reply for a folder of photos: YOROI BALANCE v1 date: 2026-10-13 date_source: ecran photos: 1, 2, 3 poids_kg: 82.4 graisse_pct: 18.2 muscle_kg: 63.5 graisse_bras_droit_pct: 15.3 tour_de_taille_cm: 84.5 autre: Intracellular water = 28.1 L FIN YOROI BALANCE v1 date: 2026-10-06 date_source: ticket poids_kg: 83.1 graisse_pct: 18.6 FIN YOROI BALANCE v1 date: inconnue date_source: inconnue tour_de_hanches_cm: 98 tour_bras_droit_cm: 36.5 FIN

Skeletal muscle mass (SMM) represents the voluntary muscles of your body. MEASUREMENT: At navel level, standing, after a normal exhale.

Marcher en pente fait travailler ton cœu: Walking on an incline works your heart at moderate intensity, without the impact of running. A study of 12 overweight adults shows that by walking more slowly with an incline (2.7 km/h at 6°), effort stays moderate and the load on the knee drops by 19 to 26% compared with fast walking on the flat. The study is small.
Étude : Ehlen et al. (2011), Med Sci Spo: Study: Ehlen et al. (2011), Med Sci Sports Exerc
C'est la Première Loi de la Thermodynami: This is the First Law of Thermodynamics. Whatever the diet (Keto, Fasting, Paleo), without a deficit there is no fat loss. Kevin Hall's work (NIH) shows that energy balance drives weight, not insulin alone.
San Millán et Brooks ont comparé des cyc: San Millán and Brooks compared professional cyclists, moderately active people and people with metabolic syndrome. The more lactate rises during effort, the less the body uses fat. Lactate therefore reflects your 'metabolic flexibility': the ability of your cells to use fat as fuel. The study compares profiles, it does not test a training program.
45-60 min en continu, 1 à 2 fois/semaine: 45-60 min nonstop, 1 to 2 times/week. Stay strict: if you're out of breath, you're no longer in zone 2.
Étude : San Millán & Brooks (2018), Spor: Study: San Millán & Brooks (2018), Sports Med
Vise 1,4 à 2 g par kg de poids et par jo: Aim for 1.4 to 2 g per kg of body weight per day. One source at every meal.
Les fibres solubles gonflent dans l'esto: Soluble fiber swells in the stomach and triggers the release of GLP-1 (the satiety hormone mimicked by a diabetes drug used for weight loss). It also feeds the microbiome, which helps regulate weight.
Chez des sportifs adolescents, dormir mo: In teenage athletes, sleeping less than 8 h was associated with a 1.7 times higher risk of injury. Lack of sleep raises cortisol (catabolic) and blocks growth hormone. It's during the night that fat is oxidized and muscle repairs itself.
Boire de l'eau augmente un peu ta dépens: Drinking water slightly increases your energy expenditure, but the effect is small. A first study of 14 people had found +30% after 500 ml of water. This figure was not replicated: a later study measured about +4.5% over an hour with cold water, and no effect with room temperature water. Beyond a loss of 2% of your body weight in water, your endurance performance drops, especially in the heat (ACSM, 2007).
Études : Boschmann et al. (2003) et Brow: Studies: Boschmann et al. (2003) and Brown et al. (2006), J Clin Endocrinol Metab
Le Dr Levine a observé que des personnes: Dr. Levine observed that sedentary, mildly obese people sat about 2 h more per day than lean people. Moving as much as they do would represent about 350 kcal more per day. The study is small (20 people).
La musculation régulière est associée à: Regular weight training is associated with a longer life.
Une méta-analyse de 2022 (16 études d'ob: A 2022 meta-analysis (16 observational studies) shows that weight training is associated with a roughly 15% lower all-cause mortality risk. The biggest benefit appears around 30 to 60 min per week. It preserves muscle mass (sarcopenia) and improves insulin sensitivity.
C'est le complément le plus étudié et l': It's the most studied supplement and one of the most effective for short, intense efforts. After a loading phase, performance on repeated intense efforts often improves by 10 to 20%. Combined with training, it also helps build strength and muscle. Its effects on the brain are still being studied.
5g par jour, tous les jours. Monohydrate: 5g per day, every day. Monohydrate (the cheapest form is the best). No loading phase needed: without it, your stores fill up in 3 to 4 weeks.
Dans une étude de Schoenfeld sur 21 homm: In a study by Schoenfeld on 21 trained men over 8 weeks, those who rested 3 minutes gained more strength than those who rested 1 minute, with a trend toward more muscle. The study is small. Rest allows phosphocreatine to be restored and keeps intensity up.
Bouger légèrement après un effort intens: Moving lightly after intense effort helps clear lactate.
Après un effort intense, une récupératio: After intense effort, active recovery (jogging or easy cycling) lowers blood lactate faster than sitting. In a small study of 10 men, the fastest clearance came from an intensity close to the lactate threshold.
Étude : Menzies et al. (2010), J Sports: Study: Menzies et al. (2010), J Sports Sci
Les étirements statiques longs juste ava: Long static stretching right before effort can reduce strength.
Behm montre que des étirements statiques: Behm shows that long static stretching right before effort can slightly lower strength. Short, pain-free stretches (less than 90 s total per muscle) have little effect, and dynamic stretching doesn't have this drawback. In a separate session, static stretching improves flexibility.
Au repos, 1 kg de muscle brûle environ 1: At rest, 1 kg of muscle burns about 13 kcal per day, versus 4.5 kcal for fat. Gaining 5 kg of muscle means about 65 kcal more per day. That's modest: the real benefit of muscle is your health and your strength.
3-6 mg/kg de caféine améliore la perform: 3-6 mg/kg of caffeine improves endurance performance by about 2 to 4% on average. Effects on strength and sprinting exist too, but vary more. Blocks adenosine = less perceived fatigue.
L'hormone du stress, quand elle reste él: The stress hormone, when it stays high for a long time, can slow your recovery.
Chez des femmes en bonne santé, celles q: In healthy women, those who stored more fat around the belly secreted more cortisol under stress. The study shows a link, not a cause. Lasting stress can also disrupt your sleep and recovery.
Lally et al. (2010) ont suivi 96 personn: Lally et al. (2010) followed 96 people for 12 weeks. Result: a median of 66 days to reach automaticity. The range goes from 18 to 254 days depending on the person and the habit. Missing a day changes almost nothing.
Le sommeil profond (stade N3) est la pha: Deep sleep (stage N3) is the phase when your body recovers the most physically. A large share of the day's growth hormone is secreted during this phase, mostly early in the night.
Le sommeil fixe les gestes techniques ap: Sleep locks in the technical moves learned during the day. In a study by Walker (2002), a finger sequence learned in the evening was about 20% faster after a night of sleep, versus almost nothing after 12 h awake. This gain was mostly linked to the light sleep late in the night (stage 2): a full night matters. In mice, sleep also helps the brain clear its waste.
Évite l'alcool le soir : il fragmente la: Avoid alcohol in the evening: it fragments the end of the night and reduces REM sleep. Do sports, but avoid intense effort right before bed. Keep a consistent schedule. The ideal temperature is 18-19°C.
Le sommeil REM (paradoxal) est la phase: REM sleep (paradoxical sleep) is the dreaming phase. It makes up about 20 to 25% of an adult's night, and the late-night cycles contain the most.
11 basketteurs universitaires ont visé 1: 11 college basketball players aimed for 10 h in bed per night for 5 to 7 weeks. Their sprint went from 16.2 to 15.5 seconds and their accuracy on free throws and 3-pointers improved by about 9%. They also felt less tired. The study is small and has no control group, but it shows that longer nights can help.
Dors 7 à 9 h, et allonge tes nuits en pé: Sleep 7 to 9 h, and lengthen your nights during heavy training periods if you can. Getting up too early cuts the last cycles, the ones richest in REM sleep. Alcohol in the evening also reduces REM sleep.

Heel hooks, twisting knee locks and reaping: only in no-gi, adult division, brown and black belts.

Au poids du corps : quand tu dépasses le: Bodyweight: when you go past the top of the range, move to a harder version.
Exercice tenu : choisis une charge que t: Hold exercise: choose a weight you can hold for the whole time shown, without letting go before the end.
Tu fais les répétitions indiquées, mais: You can do the reps shown, but no more than 1 or 2 extra. If you could do many more, the weight is too light.
Les dernières répétitions sont dures, il: The last reps are hard, you have 1 to 3 left in reserve. Your technique stays clean to the end.
Beaucoup de répétitions : finis près de: Lots of reps: finish close to failure, otherwise the set counts for little. Light or heavy, muscle grows just as much if you go close to failure.
Tu fais plus que le haut de la fourchett: You do more than the top of the range two sessions in a row: add a little weight next time, about 2 to 10 %.
Tu n’arrives pas au bas de la fourchette: You cannot reach the bottom of the range: take off a little weight. A weight done well beats a weight that is too heavy.
Pas besoin d’aller à l’échec: No need to go to failure
Garder 1 à 3 répétitions en réserve fait: Keeping 1 to 3 reps in reserve gives the same progress, with less fatigue and less risk.
Push Pull + Upper Lower, 4 jours, jambes: Push Pull + Upper Lower, 4 days, legs once
Le meilleur des deux : un PPL en début d: The best of both: a PPL at the start of the week, an Upper Lower at the end. Five sessions, every muscle trained twice.
Ordre : Push, Pull, Legs, un jour de rep: Order: Push, Pull, Legs, a rest day, Upper, Lower, then rest at the weekend.
Pourquoi ce mélange : le PPL donne une g: Why this mix: the PPL gives each muscle group one big session, the Upper Lower trains it again a few days later. Every muscle is hit twice a week.
Deux passages par semaine, c’est ce qui: Two sessions a week let you do 12 to 16 sets per major muscle without endless workouts. Volume is what mainly builds muscle; frequency helps strength a little more.
Environ 12 à 16 séries par semaine pour: About 12 to 16 sets a week for chest, back and thighs, the range recommended for trained lifters. Arms get fewer direct sets: presses and pulls already work them.
Le jour de repos sépare Legs et Lower :: The rest day separates Legs and Lower: your legs get at least two days to recover before training again.
Tu veux sécher en même temps ? Ajoute un: Want to cut at the same time? Add a 30 to 45 minute zone 2 incline walk on a rest day: it burns energy without eating into your recovery.
Pour ceux dont les jambes travaillent dé: For people whose legs already work elsewhere, in football, combat sports or running: upper body twice a week, legs once.
Ordre : Push, Pull, un jour de repos, Up: Order: Push, Pull, a rest day, Upper, Lower, then rest.
Place Lower le plus loin possible de ton: Put Lower as far as possible from your match or your hardest session. With a Sunday match: Lower on Tuesday or Wednesday, never the day before or two days before. Shift the week if needed.
Sois honnête avec toi : tes jambes n’ont: Be honest with yourself: your legs get only one session a week, about 12 sets. At equal volume, one session builds as much muscle as two, but you will not reach as much volume as with two sessions.
C’est assez quand ton sport fait déjà be: That is enough when your sport already works your legs hard. The goal here: gain strength without showing up to the match with heavy legs.
Le foot et la course comptent aussi : aj: Football and running count too: added to lifting, running slowed muscle and strength gains, more so when sessions were long and frequent.
Semaine chargée ou jambes encore lourdes: Busy week or legs still heavy: do Lower with one set fewer per exercise rather than skipping it.
Pectoraux et dos passent deux fois par s: Chest and back are trained twice a week, with 12 sets or more each.
La marche inclinée en zone 2 ajoute de l: Zone 2 incline walking adds energy expenditure with little fatigue: you recover fast and your lifting sessions do not suffer. But your deficit is what melts fat, not walking alone.
30 minutes de marche inclinée. Sur tapis: 30 minutes of incline walking. On a treadmill, 8 to 12 % incline, between 4.5 and 5.5 km/h. Zone 2: you can still speak in full sentences. Let go of the handrails: holding them lowers the energy cost. No treadmill? Walk fast uphill outdoors.
35 minutes de marche inclinée. Sur tapis: 35 minutes of incline walking. On a treadmill, 8 to 12 % incline, between 4.5 and 5.5 km/h. Zone 2: you can still speak in full sentences. Let go of the handrails: holding them lowers the energy cost. No treadmill? Walk fast uphill outdoors.
40 minutes de marche inclinée. Sur tapis: 40 minutes of incline walking. On a treadmill, 8 to 12 % incline, between 4.5 and 5.5 km/h. Zone 2: you can still speak in full sentences. Let go of the handrails: holding them lowers the energy cost. No treadmill? Walk fast uphill outdoors.
45 minutes de marche inclinée. Sur tapis: 45 minutes of incline walking. On a treadmill, 8 to 12 % incline, between 4.5 and 5.5 km/h. Zone 2: you can still speak in full sentences. Let go of the handrails: holding them lowers the energy cost. No treadmill? Walk fast uphill outdoors.
Zone 2 : un effort où tu peux encore par: Zone 2: an effort where you can still speak in full sentences, about 60 to 70 % of your max heart rate. It burns energy without much fatigue, you recover fast and you can do it often.
Sur le tapis, monte la pente plutôt que: On the treadmill, raise the incline rather than the speed, and let go of the handrails: holding them lowers the energy cost.
30 minutes de marche sur tapis, pente de: 30 minutes of treadmill walking, 5 to 6 % incline, around 4.5 km/h. You should be able to speak in full sentences. Let go of the handrails. No treadmill? Walk fast uphill outdoors.
35 minutes de marche sur tapis, pente de: 35 minutes of treadmill walking, 6 to 8 % incline, between 4.5 and 5 km/h. You should be able to speak in full sentences. Let go of the handrails.
40 minutes de marche inclinée en zone 2,: 40 minutes of zone 2 incline walking, cycling or elliptical: you can still speak in full sentences. On a treadmill, 8 to 12 % incline and let go of the handrails.
13 adultes : marcher à 10 % de pente dép: 13 adults: walking at a 10 % incline costs more than at 5 %. Holding the rails while leaning back cut the energy cost by about a third; held standing upright, the drop was not clear.
Tant que tu peux parler à l’aise, tu es: As long as you can talk comfortably, you are roughly at or below the first ventilatory threshold: a simple intensity guide, no watch needed.
21 études : la course ajoutée à la muscu: 21 studies: running added to lifting slowed muscle and strength gains, cycling did not. The longer and more frequent the cardio, the more it slows them.
Après 4 semaines, environ 14 % de force: After 4 weeks, about 14 % more strength, mostly thanks to the nervous system: motor units fire earlier and faster.
7 personnes, 35 jours d’exercices lourds: 7 people, 35 days of heavy thigh exercises: about 39 % more strength, and a muscle already bigger after 20 days.
14 690 adultes, une séance courte par se: 14,690 adults, one short session a week: about 30 to 50 % more strength in the first year, then a curve that flattens around 1 to 2 years.
Le cardio qui dépense sans te vider: The cardio that burns energy without draining you

Elle ajoute de la dépense, mais c’est le: It adds energy expenditure, but the calorie deficit is what makes you lose fat.

L’ACSM classe 64 à 76 % de la fréquence: The ACSM classes 64 to 76 % of max heart rate as moderate intensity. No watch? The talk test is enough.
La zone 2 n’a pas de définition unique :: Zone 2 has no single definition: the numbers vary a little between watches and authors.
Monter la pente fait monter la dépense s: Raising the incline raises energy expenditure without running: walking at 10 % cost clearly more than at 5 %.
Lâche les barres : en t’y accrochant pen: Let go of the handrails: holding on while leaning back cut the energy cost by about a third. Held standing upright, the drop was not clear.
Si tu ne peux plus parler, baisse la pen: If you can no longer talk, lower the incline before cutting the duration.
Pourquoi elle aide à perdre du gras: Why it helps you lose fat
Elle ajoute des calories dépensées avec: It adds calories burned with little fatigue: you recover fast and can do it several times a week.
Ajoutée à la musculation, la course a fr: Added to lifting, running slowed muscle and strength gains, cycling did not, more so when the cardio was long and frequent. Walking was not tested separately: keep sessions moderate.
Exercise alone makes you lose about 2 kg. With diet, much more: the deficit does the work.
Plus de 150 minutes d’activité par semai: More than 150 minutes of activity a week helps you lose weight, more than 250 helps you keep it off.
En combien de temps tu prends de la forc: How fast do you get stronger?
Les premières semaines, tu deviens plus: In the first weeks, you get stronger mainly because your nervous system learns to drive your muscles better.
Débutant : des gains nets dès 4 à 5 sema: Beginner: clear gains from 4 to 5 weeks, then the muscle grows and takes over.
Après 1 à 2 ans, les progrès ralentissen: After 1 to 2 years, progress slows a lot: that is normal, not a failure.
En 4 semaines d’entraînement, la force a: In 4 weeks of training, strength rose by about 14 %, mainly because the nerve signals to the muscle became faster.
En 35 jours d’exercices lourds pour les: In 35 days of heavy thigh exercises, 3 times a week, strength rose by about 39 %. The muscle had already grown a little after 20 days.
Avec une seule séance courte par semaine: With just one short session a week, nearly 15,000 adults gained about 30 to 50 % strength in the first year.
Ensuite la courbe s’aplatit vers 1 à 2 a: Then the curve flattens around 1 to 2 years: about 50 to 60 % gained after 6 years.
Plus de séries et de séances donnent plu: More sets and sessions give more strength, with gains that slow as volume rises.
Sur un cycle de 8 à 12 semaines, tes gro: Over an 8 to 12 week cycle, your big lifts should go up. Check “Your progress” in your programme.
Si tu t’entraînes depuis des années, que: If you have been training for years, a few percent a year is already a good result.
